correctness.rationale: Every feasible length-(n-1) read has a unique missing symbol under fixed content, so the incidence graph decomposes into rotation cycles. Its integer kernel has dimension zero for odd cycles and one alternating direction for even cycles; nonnegativity gives exact inverse multiplicity. Canonical edge representatives yield both product generating functions; primitive-necklace Mobius inversion and shortest even period determine exponents and first ambiguity. Exhaustive direct independent checks cover 687 cases and 602425 source multisets; finite testing is corroborative.

broader_coverage.reasoning: General multi-strand reconstruction theorems bound code rates and give constructions; prefix/suffix composition results use a genuinely different observation. Neither inspected broader model asserts a stronger exact all-content finite-length image and singleton generating function that would imply the claim.
